name: guild
description: Continuous agent orchestration on a Turso-backed board where status is a column, not a directory. The chain is DATA: a YAML template instantiated per requirement into an execution graph, with exactly two gates — the plan is approved before anything is built, and findings, bugs and failures are presented together as one decision after review. 'guild segment' says what runs next; a ticket names a required CAPABILITY rather than an agent, so any roster member whose declared capabilities cover it is eligible and adding an agent file is the whole of hiring. It can work a shift while you are away — 'guild shift' claims bounties, runs segments, retries a failure once, commits per completed task on its own branch, and stops at the next gate, because a gate is the one decision no subagent can make; it never pushes and never touches the default branch. 'guild brief' says where the project stands, 'guild shift-report' says what moved overnight, and 'guild dashboard' renders the board as one offline HTML page, while an independent QA discipline files bugs and maps risk coverage as rows. Recovery is a journal replay. Say 'check in' to start a work session, or 'work a shift' to leave it running.
